F_Fleet_Academy.name: Fleet Academy
F_Fleet_Academy.text: Fleet Academy — a mature Fleet institution training pilots, technicians, mechanics, navigators, statesmen and junior officers. It teaches doctrine as a tool for judgment, not as catechism. Visual identity follows Fleet blue/gold/white.

F_Aurelian_Crown.name: Aurelian lineage
F_Aurelian_Crown.text: Aurelian lineage lens — guardianship, record, continuity and the claim that what is not preserved cannot later be defended or rebuilt. Historical reconstructions predate the formal Crown and must not use mature uniforms. Failure mode: preservation can become ossification, delay or rule by precedent.

F_Cerulean_Crown.name: Cerulean lineage
F_Cerulean_Crown.text: Cerulean lineage lens — beacon networks, coordination, command and shared situational awareness across separated communities. Historical reconstructions predate the formal Crown. Failure mode: coordination can harden into centralization that treats local lives as variables in a system.

F_Ember_Crown.name: Ember lineage
F_Ember_Crown.text: Ember lineage lens — sovereignty as burden: somebody must decide, ration and accept responsibility when ordinary consensus cannot act quickly enough. Historical reconstructions predate the formal Crown. Failure mode: emergency authority can always find another emergency.

F_Tempest_Crown.name: Tempest lineage
F_Tempest_Crown.text: Tempest lineage lens — momentum, initiative and decisive force when waiting itself creates lethal risk. Historical reconstructions predate the formal Crown. Failure mode: uncertainty can become a reason to escalate before alternatives are understood.

F_Aegis_Crown.name: Aegis lineage
F_Aegis_Crown.text: Aegis lineage lens — protection, convoy integrity and the duty to stand between danger and vulnerable people. Historical reconstructions predate the formal Crown. Failure mode: every shield defines a perimeter and somebody can remain outside it.
